aboutParagraphs: Durham Heating & Cooling is a heating and air conditioning company based right here in Ellettsville. We install, maintain and repair furnaces, air conditioners and heat pumps for homeowners and businesses across the area.
Our focus is efficiency: heat pump installations, furnace replacements and ductwork designed to minimize energy waste, so you stay comfortable and spend less doing it.
Our neighbors noticed. Durham was named a Nextdoor Neighborhood Favorite in 2024.
